claims.statement: EU electricity rules require participation of demand response through aggregation and non-discriminatory treatment alongside producers.
PSE states that Poland's capacity market includes demand-side-response services and verified capacity obligations.

contrary_evidence: Established aggregators already possess market access and operational portfolios.
Small sites may not generate enough flexibility value after hardware and settlement costs.

economics.acquisition_route: Unvalidated hypothesis: recruit sites through energy auditors, cold-chain vendors, and renewable installers.
economics.founder_net_worth_path: Unvalidated hypothesis: 150 MW of reliable distributed flexibility could support a 5 million PLN founder net-worth path in seven to eleven years.
economics.founder_time: Unvalidated hypothesis: a market-access partner handles operations while founder work stays below 20 hours weekly before scale.
economics.gross_margin_basis: Unvalidated hypothesis: software settlement could reach 45% gross margin after market-access fees, and every commercial number including capital_required_pln is hypothetical.
economics.payback: Unvalidated hypothesis: site acquisition pays back within twelve months of verified dispatch revenue.
economics.pricing: Unvalidated hypothesis: retain 25% of verified flexibility revenue plus 300 PLN per site monthly.
economics.retention_or_repeat: Unvalidated hypothesis: recurring capacity obligations and energy savings keep sites enrolled.

fingerprint.compounding_advantage: A site-level dispatch-performance history improves forecasting, certification, and portfolio reliability
fingerprint.customer: Polish cold stores, retail chains, workshops, and EV depots with controllable load
fingerprint.offer_and_business_model: Device onboarding, forecasting, aggregated bidding, dispatch, and auditable payout settlement
fingerprint.payer_and_paid_event: The market-access counterparty pays for verified availability or dispatch and the operator shares proceeds with sites
fingerprint.problem_trigger: A site has flexible electrical assets but cannot independently monetize them

founder_fit: Forecasting, optimization, and renewable channels align strongly with founder assets.
The operational risk requires a partner-led pilot before any job transition.
risks: Dispatch failure can trigger penalties and damage customer operations.
Balancing, collateral, and certification requirements may exceed available capital.

structure.control_point: Baseline, dispatch instruction, meter evidence, and participant payout ledger
structure.critical_dependency: Certified market access, balancing responsibility, and reliable device telemetry

thesis: Aggregate controllable cold stores, batteries, heat pumps, and EV depots into a metered flexibility portfolio with transparent settlement.
title: SME Flexibility Meter and Settlement Operator
uncertainties: No market-access partner or site has committed to the proposed revenue share.
All commercial numbers including capital_required_pln are unvalidated hypotheses.
